title: OscInt: uniform oscillatory-integral estimates in Lean 4 and Mathlib
description: A Lean 4 + Mathlib library of machine-checked uniform oscillatory-integral estimates: the one-dimensional van der Corput lemma with explicit constants, non-stationary and nondegenerate stationary phase uniform in a linear term, the uniform fold estimate m^{-5/6}, the uniform D4 (umbilic) estimate t^{-2/3} for both umbilics, the D4 limit t^{2/3}∫e^{itφ}A → c_C A(0) with a Gamma-free constant, and c_C > 0. Statements are frozen and timestamped before their proofs and replayed by six independent kernels.
